Definition: a Kohathite (collectively) or descendants of Kehath
BiblicalUsage: Heman the singer is of the sons of the Kohathites, and the Levites of the children of the Kohathites and the Korhites stand up to praise the LORD with a loud voice. The word is the family name, the descendants of Kohath.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Kohathites carried the holy things and sang the praise, and both callings belong to one family.
